idea-plugin.name: Jenesis
idea-plugin.description:
Loads a Jenesis build into IntelliJ IDEA and runs its selectors.

  • Opening a project that carries build/jenesis/Make.java offers to load its modules, which Jenesis writes with its ide/idea selector: one module per module of the build, with its sources, tests and resolved libraries.
  • A banner on pom.xml, module-info.java, jenesis.properties and the files of a build.jenesis folder offers to load the build again once one changed. Tools | Load Jenesis Build does so at any time.
  • A Jenesis run configuration runs any selectors, as stage or +module/test, with -Djenesis.* settings.

Jenesis runs on JDK 25 or newer: the project SDK, another configured JDK or JAVA_HOME.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Loading a build through ide/idea, a banner on changed build files and a run configuration for selectors.

action.description: Write the modules of the Jenesis build with its ide/idea selector and reload them
